title: Morning Brief — Tuesday, 13 October 2026
description: The Reserve Bank holds the cash rate steady at 4.35%, Queensland locks in builders for the new Toowoomba Hospital's mental health and acute beds, and the Gold Coast gets a contractor for the new Coomera Hospital as plans to extend the light rail south are officially shelved. 한국어 방송도 이어집니다.
